official.status_note: On 2026-10-10 the scheme no longer appeared anywhere on the University's official international postgraduate funding listings or scholarship search; no current round, deadline or value is published on official pages

verification.notes: The dedicated Edinburgh Global Research Scholarship page returns HTTP 404 and the scheme is absent from the current official funding-for-international-students page and the official scholarship search; only aggregator sites still quote figures, which were not used, so nothing could be confirmed.

applicant_utility.summary: The Edinburgh Global Research Scholarship no longer appears on the University of Edinburgh's own funding pages - the dedicated URL is dead and the scheme is missing from the current international funding listings and scholarship search - so do not build a funding plan around it or trust the euro-pound figures quoted by aggregators. For 2026-2027 the University's official PhD funding route is the Edinburgh Doctoral College Scholarships, which the University currently advertises as covering University tuition fees plus a stipend at the UKRI rate (GBP 20,780 for 2025-2026), awarded for three to four years. Check the official funding pages and the scholarship search directly before applying, and contact your prospective school about school-level awards, because much PhD money at Edinburgh sits at school rather than central level.
applicant_utility.best_fit: Overseas-fee PhD applicants to Edinburgh who need a current, officially verified funding route - realistically the Edinburgh Doctoral College Scholarships and school-level awards rather than this legacy scheme.
application_readiness_checklist: Verify any Edinburgh scholarship listing against the official funding pages on the day you apply, and keep a dated screenshot
Check the Edinburgh Doctoral College Scholarships page for the current tuition-plus-stipend award and its terms and conditions PDF
Contact the academic school you want to join, since many PhD awards are advertised and decided at school level
Confirm your fee status classification before budgeting, because the differential only matters to overseas-rate payers
common_rejection_risks: Applying to a defunct scheme on the strength of third-party listicles that recycle stale figures
Assuming a tuition-differential award alone is full funding when it must be stacked with a stipend or studentship
Missing school-level deadlines because central pages never advertised them
applicant_utility.estimated_uncovered_costs: Unknown for this scheme. For the currently advertised Edinburgh Doctoral College Scholarships, the award covers tuition and a UKRI-rate stipend; flights, visa and health surcharge costs are not stated as covered.
document_audit: Do not submit documents to a scholarship portal that no longer exists on the official site
For current schemes, the University publishes a terms and conditions PDF - read it before relying on any summary
alerts: The historical 'early February' application window and any quoted fee-differential value can no longer be verified from official pages as of 2026-10-10
Edinburgh's tuition fees rise annually, so any fee-gap estimate from an old page understates the real differential
Treat any website quoting a specific amount for this scholarship with suspicion unless it links to a live official Edinburgh page
applicant_utility.submission_workflow: For current Edinburgh PhD funding: apply for admission to the PhD first, then complete the online scholarship application for the scheme that is actually listed (currently the Edinburgh Doctoral College Scholarships), liaising with your school.
